title: Large Language Model-based Role-Playing for Personalized Medical Jargon Extraction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the F1 score of the model's medical jargon extraction using age-specific role-playing prompts, compared against ground-truth annotations from Mechanical Turk workers of corresponding age groups.
Evaluating the F1 score of the model's medical jargon extraction using gender-specific role-playing prompts, compared against ground-truth annotations from male and female Mechanical Turk workers.

Evaluating the F1 score of the model's medical jargon extraction using education-specific role-playing prompts, compared against ground-truth annotations from Mechanical Turk workers with varying educational backgrounds (e.g., high school, bachelor's, master's).

Evaluating the F1 score of the model's medical jargon extraction using health literacy-specific role-playing prompts, compared against ground-truth annotations from Mechanical Turk workers with varying frequencies of engaging with health literacy materials.
